title: [GMCP 203.035.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Official MCP Registry discovery, validation, and publication
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-035-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: GMCP consumes the official Registry API and server.json format with pagination, filters, versions, package and remote endpoints, repository metadata, caching, mirrors and offline snapshots; validates entries before trust; and can lint and publish owned servers through authenticated workflows. Yank, deletion, namespace verification, malicious metadata, stale mirrors and registry outage behavior are deterministic and provenance-preserving. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
